constraints: Must be placed in the form method of the subform, or in the object method of one of the subform's objects.
The event is only received in the object method of the subform container.
For a custom (non-4D) event, pass a negative value to avoid colliding with existing/future 4D event numbers.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Sends an event from a subform instance up to the subform container object so it can be handled in the context of the parent form.
